items.diagram_kind: strict-transform and exceptional incidence in a point blowup
items.selection_reason: The statement relates Y′, Z′ and the exceptional E, identifies the unique point q and gives a strict intersection-multiplicity decrease; this is concrete incidence geometry.
items.concrete_diagram_content_or_checks: Draw π:X′→X, E=π⁻¹(p), strict transforms Y′,Z′, q=Y′∩E, and the conditional Y′∩Z′ contact. Check Y′≅Y, m_q(Y′∩E)=1 and the strict inequality only when q∈Z′.

source_lines.36: Assume the Axiom of Choice ([[def-axiom-of-choice]]). Let $X$ be a locally
source_lines.37: Noetherian scheme, let $Y,Z\subseteq X$ be closed subschemes and let
source_lines.38: $p\in Y\cap Z$ be a closed point such that $Y$ is integral of dimension one, the
source_lines.39: generic point of $Y$ is not contained in $Z$, and the local ring
source_lines.40: $\mathcal O_{Y,p}$ is regular. Let $\pi:X'\to X$ be the blowup of $X$ in $p$
source_lines.47: 2. $Y'$ meets $E$ in exactly one point $q$, which is the unique point of $Y'$
source_lines.50: 3. if $q$ also lies on $Z'$, then $m_q(Y'\cap Z')<m_p(Y\cap Z)$.
source_lines.52: In particular the blowup strictly decreases the intersection multiplicity at
source_lines.53: every point over $p$ where the strict transforms still meet, and if
source_lines.54: $m_p(Y\cap Z)=1$ then $Y'$ and $Z'$ are disjoint over $p$.

primary_item.title: A point blowup drops pairwise intersection multiplicity by at least one
